title: The Farmer's Wisdom and God's Instruction
description: A parable from Isaiah about the farmer's wise work: he plows and harrows, sows black cumin and cumin, plants wheat in rows, barley in its place, and spelt along the edge. He threshes each crop with the right method—black cumin with a staff, cumin with a rod, and bread grain without crushing it. This knowledge he receives from God who teaches him. Also this comes from the Lord of hosts; wonderful is his counsel and great is his wisdom.
